The '''W-series droideka''' was a model of [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], and the successor of the [[P-series droideka/Legends|P-series droideka]]. The droid's blaster arms were enlarged and a higher-yield blaster was used, which meant that they required more energy to operate. Due to this, the W-series rarely used their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]], which could be very energy-consuming. This was also their weakness: they were vulnerable to blasterfire like any other [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] without their shields. Despite this setback, however, the W-series was nonetheless an efficient unit on the battlefield with their enlarged, rapid-fire [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. They were most notably deployed at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. They were succeeded later on in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Q-series droideka/Legends|Q-series droideka]].
